o: In season two, in the growing war for control of Manhattan, Maggie and Negan find themselves trapped on opposite sides. As their paths intertwine, they come to see that the way out for both is more complicated and harrowing than they ever imagined.

eps.o: In the war for control of Manhattan, Maggie and Negan find themselves trapped on opposite sides.

eps.t: Why Did the Mainlanders Cross the River?
